# ItemDocumentWriter

*Block · writers · `linecaster.blocks.writers`*

Writes the document of each item record, one file per format: Markdown, text, HTML, DocLang, JSON.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Unit | item |
| Role | writer |
| Reads | `document` |
| Adds | - |
| Replaces | - |
| Comes after | [`Composer`](../composition/Composer.md) |
| Comes before | - |
| Used in | [`bind.v1`](../../catalog/pipelines/bind.v1.md) |
| Source | [items.py](https://github.com/storytracer/linecaster/blob/main/src/linecaster/blocks/writers/items.py) |

The contract is that of `ItemDocumentWriter(output_folder='out/documents')`; the comes-after and comes-before rows are derived from every block's contract.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_folder` | `DataFolderLike` | required | the folder (local path, fsspec URI or `DataFolder`) the documents go to. |
| `formats` | `tuple[str, ...]` | `('md', 'txt')` | the formats to write: `md`, `txt`, `html`, `doclang`, `json`; an unknown one is a `PipelineConfigError`. |
| `suffix` | `str` | `''` | added to each file's stem, before the extension. |
| `furniture` | `bool` | `False` | keep page headers and footers in md, txt and html. |
| `dividers` | `bool` | `False` | put `---` between the items of consecutive layout regions in md. |
| `by_format` | `bool` | `False` | one folder per format, `<format>/<item id><suffix>.<ext>`. |

## Behavior

It reads the item's `document` (an item-level `Composer`'s) and writes `<item id><suffix>.<ext>`
(`linecaster.formats.docling.export`); an item record without a document is counted (`no_document`). Item
records pass through.

## Contract

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    B["ItemDocumentWriter"]
    r0["document"] --> B
    B --> a0["item stream"]
```
